cohort: 338 pregnant women (168 SARS-CoV-2 positive at delivery, 170 SARS-CoV-2 negative)
finding: SARS-CoV-2 positive women at delivery had shorter labor length and lower incidence of postpartum hemorrhage, but no differences in mode of delivery or neonatal outcomes compared to SARS-CoV-2 negative women.
mod_finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection at delivery was not associated with differences in mode of delivery.
